questions: How many devices did you fabricate and measure, and how many showed a field-free diode effect with Bcf < 0 and Bcb > 0? Your text says "our NbSe2/CrBr3 devices consistently exhibit the opposite condition" (p. 3), and the figures show devices #1 and #3.
Why were the others set aside, including device #2 if it was measured?
Which ranges of field, temperature and training field did you measure beyond the ones shown (Fig. 2 covers −50 to 50 mT at 200 mK), and how fine was the field step near zero?
What does the second-best device or dataset look like, for example the Fig. 2 field sweep on device #3?

How did you set and check zero applied field after the ±6 T and ±50 mT excursions? Your η moves from 45.3% at around −10 mT to −35.7% at 0 mT (p. 2), so a remanent field of a few mT in the magnet would matter.
Which SM figure shows the control that rules out Meissner screening and self-fields, and does it include a bare NbSe2 device or region measured with the same field training?
What sets the sign of the −15.2% efficiency after zero-field cooling, and how large is the field-even part of ΔIc when you compare positive and negative training at zero field?
How did you extract |Ic+| and |Ic−| from dV/dI (peak position or a threshold, current step, number of sweeps), and will you share the raw V(I) data?
